exams.name: Dental licensure examination
exams.notes: Examination on subjects and operations pertaining to dentistry regularly taught in accredited schools; may be oral, written, or practical demonstration

exams.quote: satisfactorily passed a state or regional clinical board examination approved by the board and a jurisprudence examination on the laws of this State and regulations as they relate to the practice of dentistry

interval_years.quote: An annual registration fee, to be set by the board, shall cover fully all costs and is payable by each licensed dentist and dental hygienist and each registered dental technician not later than the thirty-first of December.

required.quote: As part of the biennial continuing education required by the board or pursuant to law, including Regulation 39-5

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry who: (1) uses the word 'dentist', 'dental surgeon', or the letters 'D.D.S.', 'D.M.D.', or other letters or titles in connection with his name which in any way represents him as engaging in the practice of dentistry or in the administration of any dental health program; or (2) for a fee or other consideration: (a) shall profess or indicate in any manner that he can or will attempt to perform dental procedures in the oral cavity and associated adjacent structures; or (b) shall diagnose or treat or profess to diagnose or treat any diseases or lesions or conditions of the oral cavity and associated adjacent structures; or (c) shall extract teeth, correct malpositions of the teeth or jaws, or take impressions, or construct, supply, repair, reline, or duplicate artificial teeth as substitutes for natural teeth, or adjust such substitutes, or do any practice included in the curricula of dental colleges accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation, or administer or prescribe drugs or therapy utilized in the treatment of dental or oral diseases, or shall use X ray for dental treatment or dental diagnostic purposes, or shall administer anesthetics, local or general, for dental procedures; or (d) shall teach or profess to teach any phase of dental practice or related procedures.
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing dentistry who: (1) uses the word "dentist", "dental surgeon", or the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with his name which in any way represents him as engaging in the practice of dentistry

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: To provide moderate enteral sedation, a dentist must first submit an application with an initial fee to the board

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board must determine the qualifications of a facility inspector and biennially inspect each facility.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: sixty hours of pediatric didactic training and twenty cases commensurate with each intended route of administration for children under thirteen years of age in order to provide pediatric deep sedation/general anesthesia

specialist_license_available.quote: A special license shall be required for the practice of each special area of dentistry recognized by the American Dental Association, in order for a dentist to hold himself out to the public as limiting his practice to, being a specialist in, or giving special attention to any special area of dentistry.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: The volume of business performed in any limited area of dentistry and the restriction of a licensed dentist's activity to any one or more limited areas of dentistry shall not in themselves constitute a holding out to the public that the dentist is a specialist.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a dentist is in the dental office, personally diagnoses the condition to be treated, personally authorizes the procedure, and before the dismissal of the patient, evaluates the performance of the auxiliary.

value: health facilities operated by federal, state, county, or local governments
education institutions accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: In hospitals, nursing homes, long term care facilities, rural and community clinics, health facilities operated by federal, state, county, or local governments, hospices, education institutions accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation that give instruction in dental hygiene, and in bona fide charitable institutions, licensed dental hygienists may apply topical fluoride and perform the application of sealants and oral prophylaxis under general supervision.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: An organization or dental practice utilizing a licensed dentist to operate one or more mobile dental facilities or portable dental operations shall register with the board by submitting an application in the form and manner required by the board

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: a written procedure for emergency or follow-up care for patients treated in the mobile dental facility or portable dental operation is kept where services are being provided

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only a dentist licensed pursuant to this chapter may control the use of dental equipment or material while the equipment or material is being used to provide dental services in a dental office

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A dentist ordering dental technological work to be performed off his premises shall issue therefor a work authorization.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Upon certification by the board and when under the direct supervision of a practicing dentist, a licensed dental hygienist may administer local infiltration anesthesia.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: Upon certification, as provided by the board in regulation, and when under direct supervision of a licensed dentist, a dental hygienist or an expanded duty dental assistant is authorized to monitor nitrous oxide inhalation conscious sedation (dental analgesia).

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Dentists shall retain their patient records for at least five years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: All dental staff who provide direct, hands-on patient care must be certified in cardiopulmonary resuscitation and the basic life support level by a board-approved training course.
